recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中，箭頭指向脂肪空泡旁一顆大型、深藍色細胞質的細胞，另在中下方可見一顆大而淡藍的細胞；在大量小型造血細胞中找這種明顯較大的藍色細胞，是辨認骨髓瘤大型漿細胞的第一步。
features: Low-power aspirate with abundant fat vacuoles and a cellular background
Arrow marks a large cell with deeply basophilic cytoplasm at the edge of a fat vacuole
Additional scattered large cells with pale to deep blue cytoplasm in the cellular trails
Background of numerous small maturing hematopoietic cells and red cells
Fine morphologic detail not resolvable at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen with numerous fat vacuoles and trails of maturing hematopoietic cells. Scattered large cells with abundant blue cytoplasm are present, one of which is indicated by the arrow adjacent to a fat vacuole. Nuclear features cannot be assessed at this power, and higher magnification is required to confirm plasma cell identity. In context, these large cells are compatible with atypical plasma cells of plasma cell myeloma; a differential count and clonality studies are recommended.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes are larger with lobulated nuclei and granular lilac cytoplasm, visible at higher power, rather than homogeneous deep blue cytoplasm.
Histiocytes have pale, vacuolated cytoplasm with phagocytosed debris rather than intensely basophilic homogeneous cytoplasm.
Reactive plasma cells are small, mature, often perivascular and polytypic, without large atypical forms or light chain restriction.
